name: osd-aa-font
summary: Anti-aliased OSD text: Noto Sans Condensed SemiBold 14 px rendered as 2-bit (4-level) glyphs, smooth edges in every text colour
status: experimental; v1 on hardware 2026-10-09: menu items showed parts of other strings, text groups kept vendor colours; v2 (descriptor tables, static palette groups, number fields) emulator-checked, hardware test pending

notes: Text tiles become 2-bit glyphs (two code slots each). Logical codes L = bank << 8 | slot map to 2-bit codes: 0x009-0x01B -> 2L+0x66, 0x020-0x150 -> 2L+0x5E, 0x151-0x181 -> 2L+0x6E, 0x1C0-0x1D9 -> 2L+0x4A; vendor icons stay at 0x300-0x30F and 0x372-0x3C9; 2-bit range from 0x078 (0x101C0A). Each text attribute gets a free palette group (6, 7, 8, 9, B-F, 3-5) with [background, 1/3, 2/3, foreground] of its 1-bit colours, reloaded after every palette load. Chinese and Japanese are not supported (their glyph set holds the second bit plane). Font: Noto Sans Condensed SemiBold (SIL Open Font License 1.1, docs/licenses/NotoSans-OFL.txt).
